#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

const long long MODULUS = 1000000007;

long long mod_pow(long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
    long long result = 1;
    long long cur = base % mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            result = (result * cur) % mod;
        }
        cur = (cur * cur) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int total_points, multiplier;
    cin >> total_points >> multiplier;

    vector<int> sequence(total_points);
    for (int i = 0; i < total_points; ++i) {
        sequence[i] = (multiplier * i) % total_points;
    }

    if (multiplier == 0) {
        cout << mod_pow(total_points, total_points - 1, MODULUS) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    vector<bool> visited_nodes(total_points, false);
    vector<int> cycle_sizes(total_points, 0);
    long long answer = 1;

    for (int node = 0; node < total_points; ++node) {
        if (visited_nodes[node]) continue;
        int count = 0;
        int current_node = node;
        while (!visited_nodes[current_node]) {
            visited_nodes[current_node] = true;
            current_node = sequence[current_node];
            ++count;
        }
        cycle_sizes[count]++;
    }

    for (int size = 1; size < total_points; ++size) {
        int c = cycle_sizes[size];
        if (c != 0) {
            long long total = size * c + (size > 1 ? 1 : 0);
            answer = (answer * mod_pow(total, c, MODULUS)) % MODULUS;
        }
    }

    cout << answer << "\n";

    return 0;
}
